detail: TC-PWD-1-10 already changes a password and proves the new credential works in a fresh browser context. Delete TC-PWD-1-04; its different valid password adds no branch or unique assertion.

The index identifies lowercase as required, but TC-PWD-1-08 supplies lowercase and no case rejects its absence. Add a password satisfying all other rules but lacking lowercase; assert Identity's lowercase-rule message and unchanged credentials.

After 'Back to the shop' the case expects the WebApp home showing the catalog with the shopper still signed in (header shows the user menu). The test asserts accountButton visible and signInLink count 0, but keyframe 07 highlights only the bare header icon, which looks exactly like the anonymous sign-in icon (compare TC-PWD-1-05 frame 07), and no catalog item is in view in 07 or 09-final (only the '101 products' heading). Only the caption claims 'still signed in'. Hover the account button so the menu with 'pwd1-change' and 'Log out' is on screen, and scroll a .catalog-item into view before the highlight. [raised by opus, sol]

Second expected result ('navigating to <WebAppUrl>/ shows the sign-in entry, not the user menu'): keyframe 07 shows a header icon that looks the same as the signed-in account button, so the absent user menu is shown only by the caption. The main expected result (login page with 'Invalid username or password') is clearly shown in frame 06. Hovering the icon to show no menu opens, or narrating the measured sign-in link, would make the frame conclusive. Minor.
